title: Building a 5v5 MOBA arena game (trailer made with Opus)
author: Techn1que
selftext:
I've probably spent \~500 hours building games with AI over the last year, and finally started working on my dream project.

It's if Battlerite and League of Legends had a baby. 

Fully multiplayer, works on pc, mac, mobile and has controller support already. Still super early though.

Would love any and all feedback!

replies.author: Techn1que
replies.body:
Yeah for sure. This is a quick trailer I threw together, and didn't feel like burning more % of my weekly limits on a refilm. 

Biggest difference is the focus on 5v5 game modes like CTF, team deathmatch, etc instead of 3 lane MOBA games. 

A lot of other smaller differences too.

comments.author: Nimbility
comments.body: Looks pretty cool! Curious if you are doing 3d model animation in Mixamo and rendering isometric angles in Blender? And if so, how are you animating non humanoid models?

replies.author: Techn1que
replies.body: Thanks! Some of the assets are bought from unity's store and come with animations, but others are made in midjourney -> tripo -> mixamo -> blender. Camera is more top-down rather than isometric. Animations are a mix of mixamo animations, bought packs, and I'm not having Claude spin up custom animations per characters with an "animation lab" I've created.
